rationale_short: Several independent rule-based/cost-aware branches have failed; current data still lacks broker-real bid/ask spread and news/event timestamps. A new candle-only scan would likely become post-hoc overfitting rather than a structurally new thesis.
stage48b_goal: Decide whether to add MT5/broker bid-ask spread capture and/or event-calendar timestamps before any new thesis scan.
hard_prohibitions: No bad bucket filtering after observed failures
No ML before a robust cost-aware baseline survives
No new candle-only scan unless Stage48A is explicitly revised with a genuinely new pre-defined structural rationale

candidate_theses_evaluated.description: Scheduled macro-news shock follow-through or fade around event timestamps.
candidate_theses_evaluated.reason: Requires reliable event calendar timestamps and news blackout/event classification. Current normalized candle set does not contain event labels.

candidate_theses_evaluated.description: Use real broker bid/ask spread and session spread regimes as the primary on/off gate.
candidate_theses_evaluated.reason: Structurally relevant because cost-overwhelm has dominated failures, but it requires MT5/bid-ask collection before any signal scan.

candidate_theses_evaluated.description: Compare broker MT5 CFD feed against REST/reference feed to detect tradable dislocations or feed risk.
candidate_theses_evaluated.reason: Requires synchronized broker feed and reference feed; cannot be tested with one TwelveData candle source.

candidate_theses_evaluated.description: Range/ATR compression followed by expansion breakout or reversal.
candidate_theses_evaluated.reason: Too similar to previous candle/session/range/ATR families and would be another candle-only rescue-like scan.

recommended_artifact_next: Stage48B data/precheck patch, not a strategy scan patch
